b: Home Depot kicked off new tool deals of the day, featuring Milwaukee, Dewalt, Ryobi, and Ridgid.
The tool deals are mostly cordless power tool deals, with power tool accessories, and also general workshop storage items.
There are a lot of deals today, many of them new. Take the time to look through the full list when you have a chance. Here are some that stood out to me:
This set of impact-rated drill bits goes from 1/16″ to 3/8″ in 1/64″ increments.
Milwaukee 80pc Screwdriver Bit Set plus 5pc Bit Holder with Carabiner – $36
The 30pc bit set is priced at $30 separately, and the bit holder set is $15. You get $45 in bits and accessories for $36.
Dewalt 20V Max 3-Tool Cordless Power Tool Combo Kit with FlexVolt Batteries – $349
Dewalt 20V Max 6-Tool Cordless Power Tool Combo Kit with Rolling Tool Box – $499
We’ve seen this deal earlier in the season, and will likely see it again. It’s a good value of the “walk, don’t run” variety.
Ryobi 18V 12-Tool Cordless Power Tool Combo Kit – $619
That’s a lot for the money. Not many cordless combo kits includes a miter saw like that.
Milwaukee M12 FUEL Compact Band Saw Kit with Grease Applicator Tool – $300
Dewalt 29pc Pilot Point Drill Bit Set – $54.47
Amazon has the same set for $85. Lowe’s has a different set with non-pilot-point bits for $65.
Milwaukee M12 FUEL Cordless Circular Saw Kit with Cut-off Saw – $249
Milwaukee 100pc Screwdriver Bit Set with Packout Organizer Case – $50
I like this assortment a lot better than the other Packout-type kits in stores right now.
Milwaukee M18 FUEL Cordless Hammer Drill and Impact Driver Combo Kit with Impact Wrench – $369
This is $30 off compared to the ongoing season-long deal.
